Get ready for some dirt, real talk, BIG FISH, and an up-close look at one of the sport’s most legendary figures. - Folks at home, - Celebrating 30 years in professional bass fishing is an incredible journey, and it wouldn’t be possible without you, the fans. Bass fishing professionally is really all about the fans, and I just want to say how much I appreciate every single one of you. I hope you enjoy the show! - NEVER GIVE UP!!! - — Ike
